*Use inverted background above for background (confirmed with scripter)

Show Symboli Rudolf (Default Racing Outfit)
Image: 1984 Kikuka Sho (https://db.netkeiba.com/race/movie/198408050410)

■Stage Direction
1 second of silence at the start
Hieeeh?! A-Are you sure it's, okay, for... me...?

Ah!! That's right, the video from back then!!
Um, Trainer! If it's a video, I can show you how I run!!

So here's a hot tip just for you. Those girls from the generation
that ran in the recent selection races... Apparently, they're at the training grounds right now!

Hey now, Tsuyo-chan! You're supposed to rest up today!
Ah... Want me to bring some water?

Waaah~! Looks like they're gonna clock another great time~!
What do you think?! From your perspective as a Trainer, how do those two look?!

—I had heard the rumors. That Symboli Rudolf was so overwhelmingly strong
she forced her training partners to feel the gulf between them, driving them to despair. And yet, this girl...

...*Yaaawn*. Is something wrong...?
Tsuyo-chan-samaaa...

—I couldn't help but dream. I want to become an Umamusume like her.
I want to follow in her footsteps... to become a "Triple Tiara Umamusume" who inherits her will—
Ever since I laid eyes on that Umamusume. Ever since that moment, I—!!

Ehehe, how does it look? She's going easy on me, but...
Still! *pant* Pretty good, right?!
Three in the morning?!

『Here I come, President!! I can still—keep going!!
——Ooooooooohhhhhhhhhh!』

Have you ever seen it before, Trainer?
The moment President Rudolf achieved the Undefeated Triple Crown!

I-It's nothing! I'm sorry!
I just woke up completely wide awake out of nowhere...

『Hah... Ahahaha—!
Not yet... Not yet by a looooong shot!』
...My dream.

(Uuu... Why did I wake up at this hour?
Do I not even have enough stamina to stay asleep...?!)

(Ugh... Sleep! Go to sleep!!
Sleeping counts as training too! Besides, today I gotta—!)
M-Me...?! Wha?! ...Whaaaaat~~...?!

You too! Tsuyo-chan is a fellow President-devotee just like me!
Please make sure not to push her too hard~.

Huh?! Teio-chan?!
No, no way, the Trainer is busy, so...

If that's fine with you, then by all means!
It was a while back, so my running was a lot rougher than it is now, though.

In that case, this way, over this way!
Spe-chan and the others are on the uphill course!

The "Emperor," Tokai Teio. On the Classic Triple Crown trail,
she was victorious in both the Satsuki Sho and Tokyo Yushun—a "Double Crown Umamusume"!

If you two are so curious about each other,
why don't you and Tsuyo-chan sign a provisional contract?

Yeah, exactly! It was well before my growth spurt.
...Yet the President still invited us to train alongside her. Taking turns, we—!

Should we run right now?! I'll change right away!
If it's mental simulation, 3000 meters is totally eaaas—*GAAAH*?! *COUGH! COUGH!*

My physical condition was in tip-top shape back then! So I ran pretty well.
This is the video... Would you like to take a look?

It wasn't just her sheer natural talent that captivated my eyes.
It was her resolute attitude in the face of Symboli Rudolf.

*wheeze*... *pant*... Ehehe,
to tell the truth, we look up to President Symboli Rudolf so much...

A few days after the selection races. As if to make up for the insights
I failed to gain back then, I spent day after day gathering info on Umamusume. But—

Guided by Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi by the hand, I moved to a spot with a clear view of the uphill course.
The two girls I had been keeping an eye on earlier happened to be running a tandem session.

I rushed over to the training track's grandstand.
Turf... not there. Dirt... not there either. All that's left is—
...? Trainer?

...And Tsuyo-chan begged the President, too!
Saying she wanted to run together!

Watching a run so brimming with raw instinct and potential, my true feelings slipped out.
I was simply, genuinely in awe... It was nothing more than an honest reaction.

You're the talk of the town, you know! The highly motivated rookie!
Always doing research on Umamusume and showing up to study sessions!
—I was completely captivated by the footage.

Symboli Rudolf! Symboli Rudolf is surging up from the inside!
Here comes Rudolf! The Undefeated Triple Crown Umamusume is now, right now—!

Fwah!? ...Uff... Mmmh—?
Fwaaah............ Mm. What ti...

The face of that Umamusume who missed her chance just like me that day wouldn't leave my head.
Guilt and regret. ...A swirl of such presumptuous emotions.

Right?! I mean, she was just so "strong"... Truly breathtaking.
Even though I'd watched plenty of races by all kinds of Umamusume before that—

Symboli Rudolf takes the Triple Crown! The Triple Crown is won!!
An immortal record! This Umamusume who resolves to win is truly "unbeatable"!!

Oh, hey! From the other day...
Are you here to observe too, Trainer?
